Q5217.reason: Costco's confirmation was expressly conditional on a $50/thousand loading charge, so under UCC 2-207 it is a counteroffer, and with no assent or performance by Rainmaking no contract formed.

Q8260.reason: Water forms only when O2 is reduced at the end of the electron transport chain, so it stops at once when O2 is gone, while glycolysis still makes pyruvate and ATP.

Q5585.reason: The question is phrased to suggest its own answer and is posed on direct examination to a non-adverse witness, so it is an improper leading question that should be sustained.
